subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Amongst the Clouds
email_body:
Hi Wendy,

Your James and Syvok Adventure chapter books take young readers to the magical island of Iceland, where James meets whimsical Icelandic companions drawn from local folklore. That blend of friendship, mischief, and Icelandic legend in Amongst the Clouds really stands out for the 7 to 12 age group.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Amongst the Clouds is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Amongst the Clouds best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
